c74object.name: evi.ladder.diode~
c74object.digest: TPT nonlinear Diode Ladder filter emulation
c74object.description:
evi.ladder.diode~ is a 'max define' for the evi_ladder_diode.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.ladder.diode~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
A 24dB Diode Ladder filter emulation, similar to the Roland-TB303 filter and not like a Transistor Ladder. Different to any of the other evieve Ladders. Unlike the (Moog) Transistor Ladder, the Diode Ladder resonance peaks, rather than scales. So be careful with high resonance! The object provides two FM modulation inlets for the filter cutoff frequency.

inlet.digest: Inlet #2: Cutoff in Hz or Pitch
inlet.description: Cutoff frequency in Pitch or Hz (default) depending on the @cutoffmode attribute.
Logarithmic FM input. Accepts an FM signal which is summed internally with cutoff in pitch prior to Linear FM inlet. This is only active if @cutoffmode attribute == 1, otherwise it is ignored.
Linear FM input. Accepts an FM signal which is summed internally with cutoff in Hz post Logarithmic FM input. This inlet is always active regardless of the @cutoffmode attribute.
Self oscillates at resonance==1 but can take higher resonance with a little loss in tuning.

attribute.name: cutoffmode
attribute.description: Switch cutoff frequency (inlet 2) between Pitch (on) or Hz (default off).

attribute.name: cutoffsmooth
attribute.description: Optionally smooth the cutoff (inlet 2). If audio rate modulating inlet 2 (or potentially with inlets 3 or 4) this should be turned off.

attribute.name: nonlin
attribute.description: 0=tanh-like, 1=polynomial-saturator, 2=cubic (default), 3=cubic-alternative, 4=atan-like. Unlike unit delay filters, TPT filters allow us to switch out the nonlinearity in the feedback loop without having to retune the filter (too much). Each option gives the filter slightly different characteristics.

attribute.name: oversample
attribute.description: 2x oversampling if on (default), 1x if off (careful). Oversampling almost doubles the CPU usage.

attribute.name: ressmooth
attribute.description: Optionally smooth the resonance (inlet 5). If audio rate modulating inlet 5 this should be turned off.

c74object.discussion: Based on the original by Dom Wurtz (2012), see the .gendsp code for the license. Thanks also to Oli Larkin. For more information about other nonlinear Ladder filters in evieve, see the 'evieve: ladder' tab of the helpfile.
